nodes.name: Ride Hailing System
nodes.what: Lets riders request rides and drivers fulfill them
nodes.why: Owns request to match to trip to charge
nodes.blurb: Requests, tracks and pays for rides

nodes.name: Rider App
nodes.what: Sends ride requests and shows trip progress

nodes.name: Driver App
nodes.what: Shares location and accepts trip offers

nodes.name: Api Gateway
nodes.what: Routes rider and driver calls to services

nodes.name: Matching Service
nodes.what: Picks nearby driver for each ride request

flags.intent: Picks nearby driver for each ride request for core marketplace matchmaking
flags.difference: Code does not perform nearby-driver match via Driver Location Cache lookup

nodes.name: Driver Location Cache (Redis)
nodes.what: Stores current driver positions for lookup

nodes.name: Trip Service
nodes.what: Tracks trip from assignment to dropoff
nodes.blurb: Tracks active trips end to end

nodes.name: H3 Geo Index
nodes.what: Indexes live driver positions by H3 cell

flags.intent: Indexes live driver positions by H3 cell to enable fast nearby driver lookup
flags.difference: Code bypasses Redis lookup and scans Postgres drivers table for closest driver instead of using H3 cell index

nodes.name: Sequential Offer Engine
nodes.what: Queries nearby cells and offers rides sequentially
nodes.blurb: Offers rides one driver at time
notes: Ranked queue by ETA then H3 ring expansion k=1..5
Single inflight offer per rideId with 10s TTL timeout
Retry max 8 drivers then requeue rider with backoff
Skip stale drivers via Redis heartbeat age >12s check

flags.intent: Queries nearby cells and offers rides sequentially to improve acceptance without spamming drivers
flags.difference: Code picks closest driver by full table scan instead of querying nearby cells and offering one-at-a-time

nodes.name: Surge Pricing Service
nodes.what: Aggregates supply and demand per H3 cell each minute
nodes.why: Price trips to balance driver supply
nodes.blurb: Sets per-cell multipliers from supply demand

nodes.name: Cell Surge Calculator
nodes.what: Divides demand by supply per cell into multiplier
nodes.why: Keep per-cell pricing consistent every minute
